sections.title: Introduction
content: This Cookie Policy explains how RedVet AB uses cookies and similar technologies on our website. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us provide essential website functions, remember your preferences, analyze site usage, and protect our services from abuse.
By continuing to use our website, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this policy.

sections.title: Overview
content: This Privacy Policy explains how RedVet Djurklinik (“we”, “us”, “our”) collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal data when you use our website and services. “Personal data” means any information that can directly or indirectly identify you as an individual.
We are committed to protecting your privacy and complying with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws.

sections.title: Who We Are
content: Data Controller:
RedVet Djurklinik
Sweden
{emailLink}
We are responsible for determining the purposes and means of processing your personal data.

sections.title: What Data We Collect
content: We may collect the following categories of personal data:
items: Directly provided data: name, email, phone number, messages submitted via contact forms.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, cookies.
Usage data: interactions with our website and services.

sections.title: Why We Collect Your Data
content: We collect data for the following purposes:
items: To respond to your inquiries and provide veterinary home visit services
To communicate important information regarding appointments
To improve our website and services
To comply with legal obligations

sections.title: Legal Grounds for Processing
content: We process your personal data based on one or more of the following legal grounds:
items: Your consent (e.g. newsletter signup)
Performance of a contract (e.g. appointment booking)
Our legitimate interest (e.g. improving services)
Legal obligation (e.g. compliance with health regulations)

sections.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
content: You have the right to:
items: Access your personal data
Rectify or erase your data (“right to be forgotten”)
Restrict or object to processing
Data portability (receive your data in machine-readable format)
Withdraw your consent at any time
Lodge a complaint with a data protection authority
sections.footer: To exercise these rights, please contact: kontakt@redvetdjurklinik.se

sections.title: Cookies & Analytics
content: We use cookies to improve your experience and analyze traffic through Google Analytics and similar tools. You can manage your cookie preferences in your browser settings.
For more details, please see our Cookie Policy.

sections.title: Data Security
content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

sections.title: Data Retention
content: We keep your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described or required by law.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
content: We may share your data with trusted third-party providers (e.g. email service, analytics) under strict agreements.
Some data may be transferred outside the EU/EEA with adequate safeguards.

sections.title: Embedded Content
content: Our website may include embedded content such as videos or fonts from third parties which may collect limited data (e.g. IP address). Please review their privacy policies.
items: Google Privacy Policy
YouTube Privacy Policy

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. The latest version will always be available on our website. Continued use of our services indicates your acceptance of the changes.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
content: By accessing or using the RedVet Djurklinik website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Services Description
content: RedVet Djurklinik provides veterinary home visit services. We aim to deliver professional and timely care to your pets at your preferred location.

sections.title: User Responsibilities
content: You agree to provide accurate information when booking appointments or contacting us.
You are responsible for ensuring pets are available at the agreed time and location.

sections.title: Appointment Booking and Cancellation
content: Appointments can be booked via the contact form or phone.
Please inform us as soon as possible if you need to cancel or reschedule an appointment.

sections.title: Payments and Fees
content: Services fees will be communicated prior to the visit.
Payments are to be made according to the agreed terms, either on-site or via invoicing.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
content: RedVet Djurklinik is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.
We provide veterinary care based on the information and access available at the time of visit.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
content: All content on the website, including text, images, and logos, are owned by RedVet Djurklinik or licensed to us and are protected by intellectual property laws.

sections.title: Termination
content: We reserve the right to terminate or restrict access to our services at any time without prior notice for violations of these Terms.

sections.title: Changes to Terms
content: We may update these Terms of Service occasionally. Continued use of the website and services constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

sections.title: Governing Law
content: These Terms are governed by the laws of Sweden.
